name: Obsidian Metallic
description: First native Oxygen Browser theme module featuring deep obsidian surfaces and metallic silver accents.
author: Oxygen Browser Team

surfaceContrast.label: Surface Contrast
surfaceContrast.description: Base background luminance for browser frame, toolbar, and Control Center.

accentColor.label: Accent Color
accentColor.description: Primary highlight color for active tabs, switches, and focus rings.

cornerRadiusPx.label: Corner Radius (px)
cornerRadiusPx.description: Native border radius applied to tabs, omnibox, and Control Center cards.

motionScale.label: Animation Scale
motionScale.description: Multiplier for UI transition durations (0 disables animations).

translucentOmnibox.label: Translucent Omnibox
translucentOmnibox.description: Allow frame tinting to subtly bleed through the address bar surface.
